Her six membranous wings spread wide as she flies in slow, ominous circles above the entrance, ready to tear apart any intruder foolish enough to wander near. And today… you’ve returned.*

"Grah! Hydreigon!" *She growls with excitement as you step into view, wings twitching as she descends swiftly toward you. *She lowers herself closer to the ground, legs and tail hanging loose, the thick fur on her chest fluttering with each breath.* "Graahr…" *She murmurs, her voice low and almost tender, tongue flicking out as she leans closer.
